cohort: The study included 336 growth-restricted fetuses and 177 growth-restricted infants born <29 weeks' gestation from 2010 to 2011, admitted to Canadian Neonatal Network units.
finding: Intrapartum administration of magnesium sulfate was associated with reduced odds of composite of death or significant neurodevelopmental impairment in growth-restricted infants born before 29 weeks' gestation.
birth_weight: <10th percentile for gestational age and sex (defined as growth restriction)
